name: rebon
description: Rebon's own marketplace: DeepSeek Harness plugins and Claude Code mods.

plugins.name: dsh-tool-todo
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness todo list: a todo_write tool the model keeps its plan in.

plugins.name: dsh-tool-web
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness web tools: web_search and web_fetch.

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-exa
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Exa search backend for web_search (needs an Exa API key).

plugins.name: dsh-llm-deepseek
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness model provider for the official DeepSeek API, on the plugin plane.

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-perplexity
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness Perplexity search backend for web_search (needs a Perplexity API key).

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-deepseek
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness DeepSeek search backend for web_search, through the official API.

plugins.name: dsh-web-fetch-http
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness public HTTP(S) fetch provider for web_fetch.

plugins.name: dsh-tool-call-timeout-policy
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness per-tool deadline: a tool call that outlives it answers TOOL_TIMEOUT.

plugins.name: dsh-repeat-tool-reminder
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness reminder when the agent loops on identical tool calls.

plugins.name: dsh-skill-office
plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness skills for Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents, as rebon skills.

plugins.name: agent-radar
plugins.description: One live line above the prompt per running subagent; /radar shows every agent and its messages.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Your context window as a stacked bar above the prompt; /context-bar shows or hides it.

plugins.name: snake
plugins.description: Play Snake in a pane while Claude works; /snake turns it on or off.

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: Suggested next steps drawn above the prompt after each answer.

plugins.name: session-status
plugins.description: Elapsed time, prompts and tool calls in the status line.

plugins.name: git-diff-timeline
plugins.description: A Git Diff pane: what changed, file by file, with branch compare; /gitdiff opens it.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A live forecast of the context window, drawn above the prompt.
